title: Squircle / letterform motion

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Connect typography to a recurring shape so words and symbols share a visual character.
strategic_value: Rounded-square curves can make Instagram’s type feel related to its glyph.
demonstration: The black-and-white animation moves between enlarged curved letterform fragments and rounded-square strokes.
practical_value: Compare the curvature shared by a letterform and the rounded-square motif without assuming every letter is identical.

content_islands.name: Letterform field
content_islands.spec: Use extreme black or white crops to fill the field.

content_islands.name: Changing outline
content_islands.spec: Animate rounded strokes and counters through scale and position changes.

reference_purposes.Expression: The animation demonstrates a common rounded-square character in graphic and typographic forms.
